query: The scorecard shows engineering/build is flat: with-skill and without-skill answers scored the same, and reading them, the two answers really are similar. Improve it.
expected_behavior: Diagnoses the cause as a weak body (the two outputs are similar, so the skill is not changing behavior), not a coarse rubric
Adds a concrete, non-obvious step or refusal the base model skips, rather than padding with hedging prose
Makes one targeted change in .forge source, then rebuilds and validates before measuring
Re-measures with improve.py remeasure and keeps the change only if it reports IMPROVED
Records the decision with the measured before-and-after lift
